tickets.summary: K-3401 NDE vibration rose from 2.1 to 4.6 mm/s in six weeks, below alarm but not plateauing; loss of this sole gas-export train would force recycle and cut production within an hour.
tickets.recommended_action: Rotating equipment specialist today to set operating/repair disposition; repair per diagnosis, verify vibration against approved limits after correction, and trend daily. Obtain source-required attention today. Check current spectrum, cause and limits.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Assessed function is continued gas-export compression by K-3401. Vibration more than doubled over six weeks, with growing 1x and sidebands and no plateau: strong progression supports the 7–8 band. Remaining below alarm limits the assessment; imminent or actual compression loss is not established.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure of this sole gas-export compression train would force platform recycle and cut production within an hour, with no spare or workaround. This establishes material operational consequences, but not the severe scale or major-accident exposure needed for a higher band.

tickets.summary: FW-8102 failed its first start, then started on attempt 2 after ~8 s cranking and reached rated pressure; batteries were 22.8 V at rest. Unreliable starting weakens fire protection; FW-8101 capacity is unverified.
tickets.recommended_action: Firewater engineer to approve operating/repair disposition; repair starting-system faults found. Reconcile impairment/deviation record. Load-test batteries; check charger/start air. Prove first-attempt start and rated pressure. Verify FW-8101 duty flow/pressure.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The assessed function is FW-8102 starting on demand to supply firewater. Its first-attempt failure during the 3 June test confirms an intermittent required-function loss. The second attempt succeeded after about eight seconds of cranking, followed by normal running at rated discharge pressure; this bounds the failure but does not erase it. The 22.8 V measurement was at rest, not during cranking, and does not establish the cause.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Failure to start removes this pump's on-demand firewater contribution, weakening fire protection. Full redundancy cannot be credited: the explicitly linked FW-8101 subsequently delivered 9.2 barg against 11 barg design on 17 June, with flow unmeasured. This supports a severe protection-loss consequence, but does not prove both pumps unavailable, inadequate combined capacity, or an extreme consequence. Both-pump unavailability would require production shutdown.

tickets.summary: PL-1002 window 2 near the low-point drain has CUI wall loss to 6.2 mm versus 7.4 mm minimum, risking high-pressure hydrocarbon release and fire; adjacent windows remain within tolerance.
tickets.recommended_action: Integrity engineer to approve operating/repair disposition, correct wall loss and wet lagging; verify boundary meets 7.4 mm minimum or approved repair design. Map CUI extent; confirm repair/deviation status. Check personnel exposure and ignition sources.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: The assessed function is containment of production hydrocarbons at wellhead pressure. Saturated insulation, heavy scaling and thickness below the minimum allowable establish advanced degradation supporting the 7–8 band. impact_of_failure.rationale: Containment failure of a live 6 inch production flowline at full wellhead pressure provides a specific severe consequence path through pressurized hydrocarbon release and potential ignition, including personnel harm. impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of inhibitor delivery creates an explicitly supported delayed integrity threat: downstream carbon steel starts corroding within weeks. There is no redundant pump. tickets.summary: Damp, rust-stained insulation at V-1201's manway suggests concealed corrosion; wall loss is unmeasured on this thick-walled first-stage pressure boundary, whose failure could release production fluids.
tickets.recommended_action: Integrity engineer to determine operating/repair disposition; correct damage if confirmed and wet insulation; verify containment to approved criteria. Reconcile impairment/deviation record. Strip manway insulation; inspect and UT. Check pressure, inventory, exposure/safeguards.

likelihood_of_failure.rationale: Wet insulation and rust staining are meaningful precursors to concealed corrosion, supporting the active-degradation band. Thickness, extent and progression are unmeasured; historical thick-wall margin does not establish current acceptance. Confirmed containment failure is not established.

impact_of_failure.rationale: Loss of the entire first-stage production pressure boundary provides a specific severe release and operational consequence path, with no redundant vessel identified. This supports the severe band, not an extreme score. Actual pressure, inventory, personnel exposure and effective safeguards remain unverified. Earlier linked piping, relief-valve and transmitter observations do not prove this vessel has failed or establish their present condition.
